epics.title: Project Setup
epics.description: Replace the placeholder module with the dashboard page shell, shared imports, and source structure needed for feature work.

stories.title: Create the loyalty dashboard page shell
stories.description: Create a `LoyaltyDashboardPage` page component and page CSS module that replace the current empty-state placeholder with a desktop-first dashboard layout scaffold inside `TeamPageLayout`.
acceptanceCriteria: A new page component renders a dashboard heading and section placeholders inside TeamPageLayout.
The page uses CSS Modules for the main layout and spacing.
The current ComingSoon-only experience is no longer the main rendered content.

stories.title: Set up typed data imports and dashboard helpers
stories.description: Create dashboard helper utilities and local typed view-model helpers for KPI, activity, and formatting needs using shared types and imported JSON data from the module data folder.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard code imports shared types from @voyado-kth/shared.
A helper module exists for formatting and derived dashboard calculations.
Data imports for members, tiers, activity, and enrollment stats are wired into the page layer without hardcoded values.

stories.title: Update module exports to replace ComingSoon
stories.description: Update the module entrypoint so the shell exports the real dashboard page instead of relying on the standalone ComingSoon component as the main experience.
acceptanceCriteria: src/index.ts exports the dashboard page entry used by the shell.
The module route resolves to the dashboard page through Index.tsx.
Unused placeholder-only exports are removed or no longer relied on for the route.

epics.title: KPI Overview
epics.description: Implement the dashboard's top-level KPI summary so program managers can understand loyalty performance immediately.

stories.title: Compute loyalty KPI values from static data
stories.description: Derive the four KPI values and simple trend metadata from the available members and enrollment datasets, including fallback logic where the source data does not directly provide prebuilt KPI objects.
acceptanceCriteria: Helpers return values for total members, active members, average points balance, and total points issued.
Trend values are available in a shape that can be passed into KpiCard components.
Numeric outputs are formatted consistently for dashboard display.

stories.title: Render the KPI summary row
stories.description: Build the visible KPI row at the top of the dashboard using four KpiCard components and responsive layout styling that supports desktop and a narrower two-column fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Four KpiCard components render in the dashboard header section.
Positive and negative trends use Essence success and danger styles.
The KPI row visually adapts to narrower widths without overlapping.

epics.title: Member Distribution
epics.description: Visualize how the loyalty base is distributed across tiers using clear, color-coded bars and summary information.

stories.title: Build the tier distribution card
stories.description: Create a tier distribution section that shows all loyalty tiers, total members, percentages, and bar widths based on tier counts and colors from the JSON source.
acceptanceCriteria: All four tiers render with name, count, and percentage.
Each tier includes a horizontal bar styled from the tier color field.
The section is wrapped in a Card and includes a visible total-members summary.

epics.title: Recent Activity
epics.description: Add an operational activity feed that highlights the most important recent loyalty events for fast review.

stories.title: Prepare filtered activity feed data
stories.description: Create activity-feed helpers that sort items newest-first, limit the list to 10 items, exclude enrollment events, and map event types to UI labels and display styles.
acceptanceCriteria: The helper returns at most 10 activities in reverse chronological order.
Enrollment events are excluded from the MVP feed.
Event labels and point-display values are ready for rendering.

stories.title: Render the recent activity feed card
stories.description: Build the recent activity list UI inside a Card using badges, simple timestamp formatting, and clear spacing so the newest loyalty events are easy to scan.
acceptanceCriteria: The activity feed renders member name, event label, timestamp, and points when relevant.
Event badges visually distinguish earned, redeemed, and tier-upgrade events.
The list is readable and consistent across the 10 displayed items.

epics.title: Enrollment Trend
epics.description: Show monthly enrollment momentum using a lightweight chart treatment that fits the dashboard aesthetic.

stories.title: Build the enrollment trend card
stories.description: Create a card that renders the 12 monthly enrollment data points in chronological order as a CSS-only bar chart with labels, values, and a highlighted latest month.
acceptanceCriteria: All 12 monthly data points are displayed in chronological order.
Bars scale relative to the maximum value in the dataset and show exact values via title attributes.
The latest month is visually highlighted from the rest of the chart.

epics.title: Top Members Leaderboard
epics.description: Add the optional leaderboard experience for ranking members by points balance after the MVP is complete.

stories.title: Build the top members table with sorting
stories.description: Create a leaderboard card that shows the top 10 members by points balance and supports simple ascending and descending sorting by relevant columns.
acceptanceCriteria: The table initially shows the top 10 members by points balance descending.
Users can sort by at least name, tier, points balance, and last activity date.
The current sort direction is visible in the table header.
